derivation:
fun hsep ι _ a b h => by
  haveI := hsep
  exact Subtype.ext (ext_of_isDominant_of_isSeparated f (a.2.trans b.2.symm) ι h)
explanation: `SchemeHomOver t f` is (abbrev) the library's subtype `{φ : T ⟶ X // φ ≫ f = t}`, so `a b : SchemeHomOver t f` have underlying morphisms `a.1 b.1 : T ⟶ X` with `a.2 : a.1 ≫ f = t`, `b.2 : b.1 ≫ f = t`, giving `a.2.trans b.2.symm : a.1 ≫ f = b.1 ≫ f`. Mathlib's `ext_of_isDominant_of_isSeparated [IsReduced X] (s : Y ⟶ Z) [IsSeparated s] (h : f ≫ s = g ≫ s) (ι : W ⟶ X) [IsDominant ι] (hU : ι ≫ f = ι ≫ g) : f = g` with `s := f`, `h := a.2.trans b.2.symm`, `hU := h` yields `a.1 = b.1`, and `Subtype.ext` finishes (the second components lie in Prop). The library's `hsep : IsSeparated f` is Mathlib's instance argument made explicit. This is exactly the current proof; Mathlib's more specific versions `ext_of_isDominant_of_isSeparated'` and `ext_of_isDominant` do not apply since the base `f` is only assumed separated, not `Y.IsSeparated`. The only work beyond the single application is the subtype repackaging, so this is a specialisation of the Mathlib lemma rather than a new statement.
